title: The gate runs only what a change can break
goal: kbgit.py sync, the pre-push hook and /kb-verify choose their checks from the changed paths: a change to kb content, ledgers or backlog items only runs the content checks (check.py, build_index.py --check, fetch.py --offline, doc2query.py stale, the leak and secret scans, rag.py eval); a change under _tools/ or .claude/ also runs the test files mapped to the modules it touched; the full tests.py and stress_test.py run only when asked (a sprint review, a manual CI job, or an explicit flag), and a test proves each lane with a planted change.

gates.question: Which checks are enough for a push that changes only kb content, ledgers or backlog items (no _tools/, .claude/, .githooks/, CI or rule file)?
options: check.py, build_index.py --check, fetch.py --offline, doc2query.py stale, kbgit.py fix --check, the leak and secret scans and rag.py eval, in seconds; no pytest
those plus the in-process content tests of test_kb.py (cohesion, leaks, lookup) and backlog.py check, under a minute
the current fast tests.py subset (KB_TESTS_FAST=1) as today
gates.recommendation: those plus the in-process content tests of test_kb.py (cohesion, leaks, lookup) and backlog.py check, under a minute

gates.question: When does the full tests.py plus stress_test.py run, once changes no longer run it by default?
options: a sprint review story's checks, and a manual CI job before a tool change is merged
nightly on the self-hosted runner plus sprint reviews
on every tool change (as today), content changes excepted
gates.recommendation: a sprint review story's checks, and a manual CI job before a tool change is merged

notes: The operator's direction (2026-09-30): the full suite on every small change makes development several times slower for little gain, worst with several agents gating in parallel on one host. Most agent commits change only content, ledgers or backlog items. Measured on the Windows host: a full tests.py run takes 18-20 minutes of wall time and 7,700-8,300 worker-seconds, stress_test.py about 8 minutes, while the content checks take seconds (check.py 0.9 s, build_index --check 0.5 s, fetch --offline 0.2 s, doc2query stale 0.4 s, kbgit fix --check 1.5 s, rag eval 5.3 s). The module-to-test map for tool changes is data (a table beside tests.py) with a test that fails when a test file names no module or a tool module maps to no test file. Changing AGENTS.md or maintaining.md's gate rule is a rule change, hence the blocking gates.
